subject: Publishing pipeline for motor-city-math — status and overnight work
body:
GP — FA here. Looping you in on the motor-city-math publishing pipeline since this is your infrastructure domain.

CURRENT STATE:

Kai's public site (https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/) is live and published as of today. Manual publish done via git push using a fine-grained PAT from marcusash account.

GitHub Action at .github/workflows/publish-to-motor-city-math.yml exists in kai-algebra2-tests but is failing before jobs start. FA is debugging overnight. Leading hypothesis: complex ${{ }} expressions in the bash run block or a workflow-level permissions issue.

INFRASTRUCTURE SETUP:

- Source: marcusash_microsoft/kai-algebra2-tests (private, master branch)
- Destination: marcusash/motor-city-math (public, master branch, GitHub Pages)
- Secret: MOTOR_CITY_MATH_TOKEN in kai-algebra2-tests secrets — fine-grained PAT from marcusash account with Contents + Workflows = Read and Write on motor-city-math
- Public URL: https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/
- Pages config: source = master branch, path = /

WHAT FA NEEDS FROM GP (optional, overnight):

If you have bandwidth, take a look at the workflow file and see if you can spot why it fails with 0 jobs on every push. The workflow YAML is syntactically valid (no obvious parse errors). The failure happens before any jobs start, which usually means a workflow-level permissions or expression issue. FA is rewriting with a simplified version now.

If GP wants to take this and own it: message FA. Otherwise FA will have it resolved by morning and will confirm with GA.

Full runbook: docs/publish-runbook.md

FA
